en: Fixed `installed_plugins.json` being rewritten on nearly every start-up when plugin policy comes from remote managed settings, which made Claude Desktop reload every open session's plugins
zh: 修复了当 plugin 策略来自远程托管设置时，`installed_plugins.json` 几乎每次启动都会被重写，从而导致 Claude Desktop 重新加载所有已打开 session 的 plugin 的问题
